name: Candidate asks 80% hike with no market or scope rationale

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a backend engineer with 5 years at a payments startup. I led the ledger rewrite and on-call rotation.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What is your current CTC and expected CTC?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Current is 22 LPA, expected is 40 LPA.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: That's nearly an 80% hike. Why are you asking for that jump from your current?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That's just what I want. I think I deserve it.
